title: Space Drums resolved configuration
description: Top-level configuration schema (Phase 01, Task 01.7; ADR-0010). Validated at load, before any computation; the resolved document is hashed into config_hash (docs/reproducibility-policy.md section 3). Every numeric value is TUNABLE and is a candidate until a phase freezes it by evidence; nothing in a config is a result. Units: seconds (_s), pixels (_px), ROI-normalized coordinates (ADR-0005), Hz, frames. Version 1.1 (Phase 02, ADR-0013): adds the optional, nullable camera_profile.pixel_format and camera_profile.grab_return_bias_s; 1.0 documents remain valid and are read as pixel_format = null, grab_return_bias_s = null. Version 1.2 (Phase 03, ADR-0014/ADR-0015): adds the optional top-level hands block (hand-landmark estimator, identity, grip parameters) and the optional top-level stick block (search region, segmentation, axis, tip methods); 1.0/1.1 documents remain valid and have neither block (the hands/stick modules then refuse to start, they never guess defaults). Version 1.3 (Phase 05, ADR-0018): adds the optional top-level geometry block (v_min, the minimum inward crossing speed of the Phase 04 valid-entry test, previously only a constructor argument); 1.0-1.2 documents remain valid and have no geometry block (the Phase 05 app then refuses to start rather than guess v_min).

schema_version.description: 1.0 (Phase 01), 1.1 (Phase 02, ADR-0013: pixel_format, grab_return_bias_s), 1.2 (Phase 03, ADR-0014: hands block), 1.3 (Phase 05, ADR-0018: optional geometry block), 1.4 (Phase 08, ADR-0022: optional features block) 1.5 (Phase 11, ADR-0028: optional commit.aux_heads block), 1.6 (Phase 13, ADR-0036: live model arm), 1.7 (Phase 14, ADR-0037: calibration_path, derived calibration block, stick.geom.l_prior_by_hand) 1.8 (Phase 17, ADR-0040: optional hands.identity.user_min_relative_area) or 1.10 (2026-10-02 live responsiveness, ADR-0044: optional stick.segment.contrast_target_range / contrast_max_gain). Minor bumps keep older documents readable (docs/architecture/contracts.md section 8).

supersedes.description: Previous config file this one replaces (docs/repo-layout.md section 3.1), or null.

status.description: candidate: development values, may not be cited by a MEASURED result; frozen: versioned <component>.<variant>.v<N>.yaml file, immutable.

profile_id.description: Id of the camera profile document (Phase 02, Task 02.10); stamped into every FrameSample.

backend.description: Capture backend name as logged by Phase 02 (e.g. an OpenCV backend id); null = library default.

requested_fps.description: REQUESTED mode only. Delivered FPS is measured (Phase 02) and lives in native_fps_measured, never here.

pixel_format.description: (1.1, ADR-0013) FOURCC REQUESTED from the backend (e.g. MJPG, YUY2); null = backend default. The negotiated format is logged by capture; it matters for the delivered frame rate (USB bandwidth) and must be recorded for reproducibility.

run_id.description: Experiment-log run that MEASURED the bias (Phase 02, Task 02.8).

grab_return_bias_s.description: (1.1, ADR-0013) bias_est of architecture.md section 5.2 for timestamp_source = GRAB_RETURN: t_capture = t_grab_return - value_s. Null (= 0, and the profile says so) until Phase 02 measures it; a number here without a run_id is impossible by schema (integrity I-5 analogue). Ignored for DRIVER_MAPPED.

value.description: Backend-specific exposure value when MANUAL; null when AUTO.

run_id.description: Experiment-log run that MEASURED the value (Phase 02, Task 02.4).

native_fps_measured.description: Reference to the MEASURED native delivery rate of this profile. Null until Phase 02 measures it. A number here without a run_id is impossible by schema (integrity item I-5).

drop_policy.description: Only policy allowed by the architecture (latency never accumulates). Drops are counted in FrameSample.dropped_since_last.

stall_factor.description: A stall is flagged when no frame arrives for > stall_factor x expected interval (tunable).

px.description: Fixed playing ROI in full-frame pixels; origin of ROI-normalized coordinates (ADR-0005). Candidate until the Phase 02 distance benchmark.

delegate.description: 1.11: explicit inference delegate; unsupported platforms fail, never silently claim GPU.

detector.description: Estimator family (Phase 03, Task 03.1 candidate: MediaPipe Tasks Hand Landmarker). A second family is added here by enum extension + ADR.

model_asset_id.description: Key in assets/models/manifest.json (file + SHA-256; docs/environment.md section 7). Selects the model file; the Tasks API exposes no separate complexity knob, so this IS the model-complexity parameter. The hash is re-verified at load and embedded in HandObservation.detector_id.

running_mode.description: VIDEO: the estimator carries its hand ROI from previous frames (causal; timestamps derived from t_capture). IMAGE: every frame independent. Candidate; decided by Tasks 03.11/03.14.

num_hands.description: Max hands the estimator may return. Only LEFT/RIGHT are ever emitted (contracts.md section 3.2); extra detections are counted, not emitted.

min_tracking_confidence.description: VIDEO-mode inter-frame tracking threshold (tunable candidate; ignored in IMAGE mode).

input.description: Pixels handed to the estimator: the fixed ROI crop (Phase 02 ROI policy, default) or the full frame. Either way HandObservation coordinates are ROI-normalized (ADR-0005; spacedrums.hands.coords).

swap_handedness.description: false: the estimator's Left/Right label is the hand_id. true: swapped. Which one matches the person's anatomical hand on a given camera path (mirrored or not) is a person-dependent check (Task 03.1 evidence note; HW-01 decided false on 2026-09-21: image not mirrored); stable identity over time is Task 03.2 (identity).

mode.description: RAW: estimator label only (Task 03.1 baseline; same-label collision keeps the higher score). TEMPORAL: label + continuity to the previous wrist position (Task 03.2).

gate_distance.description: ROI-normalized wrist displacement within which a detection is continuous with a hand's previous wrist (tunable candidate).

max_gap_s.description: A previous wrist older than this (seconds on t_mono) carries no continuity information; labels alone decide after a longer gap (tunable candidate).

w_label.description: Weight of the estimator label term in the combined identity score; the continuity term weighs 1 - w_label (tunable candidate).

ambiguity_margin.description: If the best assignment beats the second-best by less than this, the frame is AMBIGUOUS: no guess, both hands' handedness_score capped (tunable candidate).

ambiguous_score_cap.description: handedness_score cap applied to every hand in an AMBIGUOUS frame. Loader check: tracking.c_min <= cap < tracking.c_valid, so an ambiguous identity can at most be DEGRADED, never VALID (README section 8, Q33).

user_min_relative_area.description: (1.8, Phase 17, ADR-0040) single-user rule: a detection whose box area is below this fraction of the user's hand size (the larger of the largest detection in the frame and the running user-hand size) is a background hand and is never assigned. 0 or absent = off (default until the live two-person test sets it; candidate 0.35).

identity.description: (1.2, Phase 03 Task 03.2, ADR-0014 amendment) LEFT/RIGHT identity assignment parameters.

point_weights.description: Grip point = weighted mean of the named landmarks (MediaPipe ordering; weights normalised to sum 1). Task 03.3 candidate: index_mcp 0.4, thumb_ip 0.2, thumb_tip 0.2, middle_mcp 0.2.

direction.description: Grip direction prior, pointing from the hand towards the stick tip. KNUCKLE_ROW (default candidate, Task 03.3 overlay evidence): pinky MCP -> index MCP, along the knuckle row the stick lies on in a fist. WRIST_TO_GRIP / INDEX_MCP_TO_PIP: the phase document's finger-direction candidates, kept selectable.

min_direction_span.description: ROI-normalized minimum baseline length below which no direction prior is produced (degenerate hand pose).

grip.description: (1.2, Phase 03 Task 03.3, ADR-0014 amendment) grip reference point / direction prior anchoring the stick search region and the GEOM tip (spacedrums.hands.grip).

hands.description: (1.2, ADR-0014) Hand-landmark estimator parameters consumed by spacedrums.hands (Phase 03, Task 03.1). Optional at the schema level so 1.0/1.1 documents stay valid; required by the hands module itself.

method_id.description: Tip-estimation method the live pipeline runs (README section 14). GEOM / AXIS_REFINED are markerless; MARKER is the fallback / benchmark condition only: the estimator logs a WARNING and every record/overlay carries the label (REQ-211, integrity I-7).

length_factor.description: x hand span, forward along the grip direction prior (tunable candidate).

width_factor.description: x hand span, total width (tunable candidate).

back_factor.description: x hand span, backwards from the grip point (tunable candidate).

min_span_px.description: Below this hand span (px) no region is computed.

search_region.description: (Task 03.4) hand-anchored rotated search rectangle, scaled by the hand span (spacedrums.stick.search_region).

contrast_target_range.description: (1.10, ADR-0044) optional contrast-adaptive edge thresholds: when the p2-p98 grey range of the blurred search region is below this, canny_low and canny_high are divided by min(contrast_max_gain, target / range). null or absent: fixed thresholds (Phase 03 behaviour).

contrast_max_gain.description: (1.10, ADR-0044) upper bound of that threshold divisor; 1 or absent disables it.

segment.description: (Task 03.5) classical stick pixel-candidate extraction: Canny edges -> closing -> elongated, orientation-consistent components (spacedrums.stick.segment). All tunable candidates.

grip_tolerance_factor.description: x hand span: the fitted line must pass within this distance of the grip point.

inlier_dist_factor.description: x hand span: inlier band (covers both stick edges).

seed.description: RANSAC generator seed, re-applied every call (deterministic output).

support_gap_factor.description: x hand span: a gap along the axis longer than this ends the connected support.

axis.description: (Task 03.6) stick axis fit constrained to the grip (spacedrums.stick.axis). All tunable candidates.

l_prior.description: Apparent stick length prior in ROI-HEIGHT units (px / roi.h). Initial candidate from the Phase 02 distance benchmark (120 px / 440 px at 1.0 m); per-user calibration is a Phase 14 question.

refine_online.description: Causal per-hand running estimate of L from the axis support (default false: pure per-frame estimator).

l_prior_by_hand.description: (schema 1.7, Phase 14, ADR-0037) Per-hand calibrated L in ROI-HEIGHT units. Written only by the calibration resolver (spacedrums.calib); must equal calibration.l_prior_by_hand. Absent = l_prior for both hands.

max_deviation_factor.description: x L: reject the support endpoint farther than this from the GEOM tip (fall back to GEOM).

min_support_factor.description: x L: shorter support = truncated stick -> fall back.

marker.description: (Task 03.9) MARKER colour range and blob rules. FALLBACK / BENCHMARK CONDITION ONLY (REQ-009, REQ-211); the range must be calibrated per tape and lighting - the example values are placeholders, not a calibration.

stick.description: (1.2, Phase 03 Tasks 03.4-03.9, ADR-0015) markerless stick detection, axis and tip estimation (spacedrums.stick). Optional at the schema level so 1.0/1.1 documents stay valid; required by the stick module.

zones.description: Zone registry (Phase 04 implements; ADR-0003 ids; ADR-0011 extensibility). Zones are hand-agnostic by default (REQ-011).

allowed_hands.description: Reserved for future hand-zone experiments (REQ-011 / Phase 18). Omitted = both hands. Restricting it in V1 requires an ADR.

impact_surface.description: Subset of the zone boundary through which a valid entry must pass (Phase 04, Task 04.2 validates it lies on the boundary).

inward_normal.description: Unit vector pointing into the zone from the impact surface. Stored explicitly so no zone hard-codes 'down' (Phase 04).

pads.description: Full-kit pads in mirrored display coordinates: x is the centre, y the top strike edge.

developer_demo.description: Explicit app.play --demo only; fixed developer guide, never calibrated or physically validated.

product.description: 1.11 ADR-0045: measured endpoints, measured stroke geometry, automatic four-pad calibration.

v_min.description: Minimum inward crossing speed (ROI-normalized units/s) of the Phase 04 valid-entry test v . n_in >= v_min, shared by every candidate source (tunable; Phase 05 playability candidate, re-derived in Phases 07/09/18).

geometry.description: Optional since schema 1.3 (Phase 05, ADR-0018). Absent in 1.0-1.2 documents; the live app requires it.

c_min.description: Confidence in [c_min, c_valid) -> DEGRADED; below -> INVALID. Must be <= c_valid (checked by the loader).

g_max_frames.description: Max gap bridged causally in DEGRADED before INVALID.

age_max_s.description: State older than this since last VALID -> STALE.

history_n.description: Causal history window N (README section 14); the declared window for TEST-CAUSAL-2.

type.description: Filter family id chosen in Phase 03 (Pending Benchmark).

params.description: Filter-specific parameters; validated by the filter implementation.

dt_step_s.description: Step interval; horizon H = K * dt_step_s (tunable).

rule.description: Required when type = rule; null otherwise.

model.description: Required when type = model; null otherwise.

budget_s.description: Per-frame inference budget; candidates To Be Experimentally Determined (Phase 16).

fallback.description: Reserved for Phase 13 (Task 13.4); null until then.

tti_commit_s.description: tau_commit: commit when predicted impact is within this time (tunable; swept in Phases 09/18).

n_confirm_frames.description: Optional persistence requirement before ARMED -> COMMITTED; 0 disables.

allow_degraded_commits.description: Default false (README section 8). Enabling is an explicit experiment (Phase 05/17).

stale_prediction_tolerance_s.description: Reject a candidate whose t_impact_pred is in the past by more than this.

max_dropped_since_last.description: Frame-drop guard: no commit when the current frame's dropped_since_last exceeds this.

aux_heads.description: Optional (config 1.5, Phase 11, ADR-0028). Post-geometry use of multi-task head outputs for arm C-MT (models/temporal/consistency.py AuxHeadSettings). Absent = every option off: no head gates, geometry intensity. Every value is a candidate until a gate freezes it by evidence. Heads never create a candidate (ADR-0007); the Phase 05 policy itself is unchanged.

use_p_aux.description: Gate a geometry-derived candidate on the strike head: p(strike within H) >= p_aux. Off: the probability is informational only and does not reach commit.p_commit.

use_agreement.description: Gate on every enabled agreement check being true (a null check fails the gate).

position_tolerance.description: Maximum Euclidean head-vs-geometry impact distance, ROI units (tunable).

intensity_tolerance.description: Maximum |head intensity - geometric inward crossing speed|, proxy units (tunable).

intensity_source.description: Committed intensity proxy: inward crossing speed on the predicted trajectory (geometry) or the intensity head. A proxy, never force (Task 11.7, ADR-0029).

audio_profile_id.description: Id of the audio profile holding the MEASURED output latency (Phase 04, Task 04.8).

wasapi_exclusive.description: Try WASAPI exclusive mode (~5 ms) before shared mode (~22 ms); exclusive blocks other apps' audio. Default false.

stream_latency.description: PortAudio suggested output latency: 'low', 'high' or seconds. Default 'low'.

manifest.description: File listing sample_id -> file + licence + SHA-256 (Phase 04, Task 04.6).

type.description: Monotone intensity-proxy -> gain mapping (Phase 04, Task 04.10). Proxy, not force.

active.description: Arm whose commits sound (Phase 05 runtime switch; Phase 13 adds C).

arms.description: Optional in Phase 01; required from Phase 05.

calibration_path.description: (schema 1.7, Phase 14, ADR-0037) calib-v1 file applied by spacedrums.calib.load_calibrated_config. A document naming a calibration must carry the derived calibration block; plain load_config refuses one without it.

calibration_hash.description: config_hash of the calib-v1 document that was applied.

template_zones.description: The Phase 04 layout the fit started from: the model's training-layout reference (ADR-0037 model compatibility).

zones_hash.description: config_hash of the applied zones list; must equal the document's zones.

validation_passed.description: Arm A validation-strike outcome of the calibration; null = skipped.

calibration.description: (schema 1.7, Phase 14, ADR-0037) DERIVED block written by the calibration resolver together with zones and stick.geom.l_prior_by_hand; never authored by hand. Makes a resolved snapshot self-contained.
